description: Read a PDF's document info: page_count, per-page width/height (points) and rotation, title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creation_date, modification_date (ISO 8601, null when absent), whether it was encrypted, and has_form / form_field_count. Call this to learn a document's size and shape before splitting, rotating or filling. Read-only: the PDF is fetched or read but never modified.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: a path to a .pdf file inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory), an https:// URL, or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI. Use a URL or data URI when this server runs remotely (Smithery, hosted gateways) where local paths do not exist.

name: pdf_metadata

form_field_count_capped.description: True when the form-field count stopped at the 2,000 cap, so the real number may be higher

title: Read PDF metadata
